summary.text: Jutt Howard (listed by Ballotpedia as Justin Howard) is a Republican state representative from Georgia House District 71 who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is vice president of business operations for NG Turf.

paragraphs.text: Howard earned a bachelor's degree in marketing from the University of West Georgia.

His career experience includes serving as vice president of business operations for NG Turf, and he previously served as president of the board of directors of the Georgia Crop Improvement Association.
Howard succeeded J. Collins in District 71, assuming office on January 13, 2025, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Agriculture and Consumer Affairs Committee, the House Interstate Cooperation Committee and the Natural Resources and Environment Committee.
